# stackexchange

```go
import "github.com/kinorai/omnifeed/internal/engine/stackexchange"
```

Package stackexchange implements the Stack Exchange engine. It reads the public Stack Exchange API \(api.stackexchange.com, v2.3\) and renders a question URL on Stack Overflow, Super User, Server Fault, Ask Ubuntu, MathOverflow or any \{name\}.stackexchange.com site as the question header \+ body and its answers by votes \(TOON\), headed by a "\# title" line.

Like the Hacker News, GitHub and Discourse engines \(and unlike Reddit and the generic engine\), this engine fetches its upstream DIRECTLY over HTTP rather than through crawl4ai: the question pages sit behind Cloudflare, which answers crawl4ai with a 403 \("Blocked by anti\-bot protection"\), while the API serves the same content keyless. It does require omnifeed to have outbound access to api.stackexchange.com.

Keyless callers share a quota of 300 requests a day per IP; a key \(OMNIFEED\_STACKEXCHANGE\_KEY\) raises it to 10,000. A question costs 2 requests \(question \+ answers\), a short /a/ link 3.

<a name="Answer"></a>
## type Answer

Answer is one answer, in vote order. Accepted marks the answer the asker accepted.

```go
type Answer struct {
    ID       int64  `json:"id" toon:"id"`
    Score    int    `json:"score" toon:"score"`
    Accepted bool   `json:"accepted" toon:"accepted"`
    Author   string `json:"author" toon:"author"`
    Created  string `json:"created" toon:"created"`
    Body     string `json:"body" toon:"body"`
}
```

<a name="Config"></a>
## type Config

Config configures a Stack Exchange Engine.

```go
type Config struct {
    Client  *httpx.Client
    Limiter httpx.Limiter
    APIBase string        // defaults to the public v2.3 API; overridden in tests
    Key     string        // optional app key; empty = keyless (300 requests/day/IP)
    Timeout time.Duration // wall-clock budget per crawl; defaults to defaultTimeout
    Logger  *slog.Logger
}
```

```go
func (e *Engine) Crawl(ctx context.Context, rawURL string, _ domain.EngineOptions) (domain.Document, error)
```

<a name="Engine.Matches"></a>
### func \(\*Engine\) Matches

```go
func (*Engine) Matches(rawURL string) bool
```

Matches claims question URLs on the Stack Exchange network only \(see questionRE and siteFor\). Every other page on those hosts falls through to the generic crawl4ai fallback.

<a name="Question"></a>
## type Question

Question is the header of a question, stripped to LLM\-relevant fields. AcceptedAnswer is the id of the accepted answer \(0 = none\), the same id the accepted entry in Answers carries.

```go
type Question struct {
    Title          string   `json:"title" toon:"title"`
    Site           string   `json:"site" toon:"site"`
    Score          int      `json:"score" toon:"score"`
    Tags           []string `json:"tags,omitempty" toon:"tags,omitempty"`
    Author         string   `json:"author" toon:"author"`
    Asked          string   `json:"asked" toon:"asked"`
    Answers        int      `json:"answers" toon:"answers"`
    AcceptedAnswer int64    `json:"accepted_answer,omitempty" toon:"accepted_answer,omitempty"`
    Closed         string   `json:"closed,omitempty" toon:"closed,omitempty"`
    Body           string   `json:"body" toon:"body"`
}
```

<a name="Thread"></a>
## type Thread

Thread groups a question with its answers. Note, when set, tells the reader \(the LLM\) that the answer list was truncated — metadata keys land in MCP \_meta, which models never see, so the signal has to live in the content itself.

```go
type Thread struct {
    Question Question `json:"question" toon:"question"`
    Note     string   `json:"note,omitempty" toon:"note,omitempty"`
    Answers  []Answer `json:"answers" toon:"answers"`
}
```
